services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Fred
reviews.text: Took my 2008 Toyota RAV4 in for a noise coming from the front suspension. White's identified the root cause, replaced the tie rod ends, and did a front end alignment. They were professional and up front about the cost, which was reasonable. Scheduling was convenient. They completed the repair promptly on the same day. Overall, I am very happy with the work they performed. I would for sure take my Toyota back to White's Automotive if additional repairs are needed in the future.

reviews.author: Dora Gonzalez
reviews.text: I've been a Virginia resident for less than 30 days and had to Google an auto shop as my car began shaking wildly on the freeway. Mind you I just drove it over 3000 miles from FL so I expected some issues. I was worried because of how intense the shakes were I didnt want to end up pay an arm and a leg plus dealing with an area I knew no one in, I'm so happy I chose White's Automotive Repair out of the laundry list of people in the area. I cannot recommend this Automotive shop enough. Mr. White was straight to the point, very formal but also very nice. His wife Michelle was sweet, also straight to the point. I took my car in a Monday after a holiday weekend, and they were able to squeeze me in. They were clear on pricing from the beginning, there was no second guessing.

reviews.author: Mark Snowberger
reviews.text: Stan is a great mechanic. He is very knowledgeable in all areas and very professional every time I'm there. They have been servicing my vehicles for over 4 years and I have had 0 complaints. Michelle always does her best to fit me in ASAP and always has nice conversation with me. 5 star business definitely!

reviews.author: Deana Corley
reviews.text: Got my state inspection done. Quick and painless. I have a 2013 Rav 4. No ridiculous charges or findings. Straight up, honest people. I definately recommend.

reviews.author: Patrick Hatfield
reviews.text: If it wasn't for my employer who uses him I wouldn't have known about this place. Stan did excellent work for my water pump. Great work and prices. I will be in touch and let others know about this place when they need there vehicles worked on. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Michael Metler
reviews.text: I was worried about finding a good mechanic in the area because I needed to have my heater core replaced (which is both expensive and difficult). It’s been a few weeks now since I had my Jeep fixed here and everything is working great! The pricing was super fair and they offer a military discount if that applies to you. They communicated really well and I could tell they really care about getting the job done right. Stan did mention something else small he noticed that was broken but didn’t push me to get it fixed at all. Rather he offered advice on how I could probably easily fix it myself cheaper. 100% recommend and will be back in the future if I have any more issues.

reviews.author: MES
reviews.text: My parents have been taking their cars to Stan for over 20 years and I take my car there as well. Stan and his wife, Michelle, are so nice and they are straight forward/to the point. They will not rip you off. I highly recommend this auto shop.

reviews.author: Sarah Carlton
reviews.text: Great experience with them! They were able to fix my Explorer when it was making terrible noises. They do a great job of explaining both what was wrong and what they did to fix it. They warned me about the potentially high price range of the job I needed done (to the AC unit), and when the problem turned out to be not as bad as expected, the price was much lower. Very open and honest people. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Carrie Johnston
reviews.text: I chose them the first time I needed repairs after moving to Chesapeake. They were amazing and the day of my appointment they did awesome work and returned the car first thing the next day, but would have had it back the same day if I wouldn't have been late for my appointment which made it to late for them to get a part. The prices were more than reasonable. The next time I needed a repair I just stopped by to see if they were able to make an appointment and Michelle asked if I could leave it and of course I did. I took uber home and Michelle called within 2 hours to let me know the car was finished. Once again awesome work not to mention efficient and reasonable price. I will definitely be back for inspection in a few months. I highly recommended them. I never leave reviews but felt like I had being they are amazing. Thanks ya'll and I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Kathy Temples
reviews.text: First time there. Super nice very knowledgeable person in the office. Got the car back faster than expected. Good bunch of people there, very nice. Typical auto shop from the old school, not a pretty dealership showroom with the showroom price either. And the car is fixed. Win win!

reviews.author: Kristin Fleetwood
reviews.text: They were recommended to me by our family mechanic and they have been absolutely awesome! Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Karen Waters
reviews.text: Twice I have had my vehicles inspected here and they let me know if there may be an upcoming issue. I took my Jeep in because they were making noises and figured it may be about the time the pads needed changed. Dishonest shop would have done the brake job but Michelle called to tell me they were fine, where they were & what the inspection minimum was. Trustworthy shop & highly recommend for your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Brandon Elder
reviews.text: Called a week ago and made an appointment to get an oil change after 5 and even ask twice on the phone if he would be able to do it and was told yes. I left work early as I could to get there at 5 to just be turned away saying I misunderstood and my appointment was at 8am. I won't be back and wouldn't recommend to anybody. Also he was pretty rude about it with no manners whatsoever towards my wife or myself and was cussing in front of my 2 small children.

reviews.author: Brittany Lucas
reviews.text: I love White's automotive. Stan is an amazing mechanic. Sadly he doesn't have enough mechanics to get everything done as quick as the general public would like but when he gets a job done it's perfect I cannot recommend them highly enough Sans wife is sweet and is always able to work with me when I can come in and get my car serviced and they're awesome.

reviews.author: kiMBERLY hALL
reviews.text: Stan is awesome. I'm not from here so I was skeptical of taking my car in for repair. Stan only fixed what needed to be and was very reasonable and knowledgeable. My go to place from now on. I really appreciated the service I was provided.

reviews.author: Andreas Kouremenos
reviews.text: Having read previous good critiques and comments i decided to go there and diagnose a problem i had with my car. Didnt finally get any diagnosis done cause they do not make time appointments, not even for checking and diagnose the problem. There is only drop off daily appointments, and it doesnt suit me cause i cant leave the car and wait all day long there for a possibly 30-40 mins diagnosis- i dont have a replacement car, or anyone to pick me up. I guess they do this due to covid 19 which is acceptable of course. Since i got there in person though in order to make the appointment, i need to say that this place is clean and looks organized. So i guess they do a good job as other comments say.

reviews.author: Nathan Hernandez
reviews.text: An honest and competent mechanic. Far better than dealership mechanics, White's won't try to invent problems that don't exist with your car to get extra money. They'll tell you what's up and do work for a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Tim&Em
reviews.text: Got my car inspected here last week and no fake issues, like the usual places that always find “Something” that has to be fixed. I will be back, got 3 cars all older. I am hoping I found my new mechanic.

reviews.author: Thomas Mott
reviews.text: We made an appointment for an annual inspection. Everyone was very nice and the inspection was done promptly. Great place. Be sure to call if you need service.

reviews.author: Josh Smith
reviews.text: Very knowledgable and trustworthy shop. I moved to Chesapeake from New York and got screwed over by several shops before I found these guys. I've been using White's for about 4 years now and will continue to do so. They're the only people I trust in the whole area.

reviews.author: laurie simon
reviews.text: Dropped my car off Monday, ready Tuesday morning. Fixed my driver side window that wouldn't role down. Very happy with the service and price!!

reviews.author: Jeni Leonetti
reviews.text: Always great service and great pricing too. Stan and Michelle are awesome to work with... I don't take my car anywhere else for state inspection or repairs

reviews.author: Justin Stark
reviews.text: 1st time dealing with them, needed an inspection bad and they were able to fit me right in. Dropped my car off and got a call shortly after that it was finished and good to go.

reviews.author: tim zweizig
reviews.text: Outstanding auto repair shop! Dependable, Honest, willing to go extra mile for customers. Nice to do business with hard working local companies instead of the chains. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kimberly Lucas
reviews.text: White's is by far the most reliable, honest and accommodating automotive repair shop. My family have taken all our cars to them and have always been very satisfied.

reviews.author: Justin Crump
reviews.text: Stan is honest and cares about his customers. Saved me over $3000 compared to Priority Toyota's pricing.

reviews.author: Kelly Ellis
reviews.text: Based off reviews I called to schedule service - unfortunately they only offer hours Monday-Friday 8am-6pm. For those of us who work full time during the week and have trouble requesting time off, these hours are just not accommodating. Some sort of weekend hours would be super helpful!

reviews.author: jeffrey james
reviews.text: Stumbled across this shop by accident. They are a family owned business and very knowledgable. Fantastic work! I will be visiting them again this week for some more repairs.

reviews.author: Stephen White
reviews.text: Great to work with in helping me with my car and the service was a great price. Will use them again for any of my auto needs.

reviews.author: N DR
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Had them do my husband's state inspection on his vehicle last year. I will be returning to this place every year until they close.

reviews.author: Donny Lock
reviews.text: Honest people, fair prices and will work to get your service done timely. Will be going there as long as we are in Chesapeake.

reviews.author: Doug Raeder
reviews.text: Kind, reasonable, and honest. They fixed the issue with our van and didn't try to sell us anything extra.

reviews.author: Billy Hartley
reviews.text: Best place to get any automobile fixed the right way. Stan is the only one that will work on my vehicles.

reviews.author: James Holman
reviews.text: I absolutely recommend White's for your auto repair needs. The staff is polite, friendly & professional.
